site.name: Acerola
site.description: Documentation for Acerola — a local-first comic and manga reader that syncs your library between your own devices over P2P, with no cloud, no account, and no server to trust.
site.keywords: comic reader, manga reader, P2P sync, local-first, self-hosted, Android, desktop, Tauri, Kotlin, Rust, open source

og.title: Acerola — Local-first comic & manga reader
og.description: Read your comics and manga on any device. Acerola syncs your library straight between your devices over P2P — no cloud, no account, no lock-in.
og.image_alt: Screenshot of the Acerola docs homepage

landing.hero_title: Read your comics and manga on any device. No account, no cloud.
landing.hero_subtitle: Your library stays on your devices and syncs directly between them over encrypted P2P — no server stores or sees your data.

features.title: Built around one idea: your library is yours

no_cloud.title: No cloud, no account
no_cloud.desc: Your comics, progress, and metadata stay on your devices. No sign-up, no central server.

p2p_sync.title: Direct P2P sync
p2p_sync.desc: Devices connect straight to each other over iroh/QUIC. When a direct connection isn't possible, a relay just helps them find each other — it never sees your library.

open_source.title: Open source
open_source.desc: Every platform — Android, desktop, and the sync libraries — is MPL-2.0 and open for anyone to read, build, or audit.

how_it_works.title: From install to synced, in three steps
how_it_works.install: Install Acerola on the devices you want to sync — download the Android APK or build the desktop app from source.
how_it_works.pair: Open Network on both devices and scan the QR code shown on one with the other.
how_it_works.confirm: Confirm the pairing. From then on, your library and reading progress sync automatically, device to device.
how_it_works.note_desc: Acerola falls back to a relay (self-hosted or ours) just to help peers find each other — no port forwarding needed, and it never touches your library.

android.title: Android
android.desc: Native app in Kotlin + Jetpack Compose.

relay.title: Relay
relay.desc: Remote access service with no port forwarding, deployable to a VPS.

p2p.title: lib/p2p
p2p.desc: Shared P2P library in Rust, built on iroh/QUIC.

relay_lib.title: lib/relay
relay_lib.desc: Vendored iroh relay code, the base for the relay service.

architecture.title: Built to give you total control over your data
architecture.desc: See how Acerola combines Rust, iroh/QUIC, and open standards to ensure privacy and maximum speed.

p2p.title: Direct P2P Protocol
p2p.desc: Direct secure connection between your devices using QUIC and iroh. No intermediary servers to read or store your comics.

relay.title: Optional Self-Hosted Relay
relay.desc: Host your own relay on a VPS with Caddy or Docker to connect devices behind restrictive NAT.

metadata.title: Metadata and Open Standards
metadata.desc: Full ComicInfo.xml compatibility and automatic sync with MangaDex and AniList with zero lock-in.
